name: Porcelain Tea Sea
description: A vast ocean made of delicate porcelain tea cups and saucers floating on mirrored liquid, each cup containing a tiny glowing galaxy, with steam forming soft clouds above.
prompt: Endless sea of floating porcelain teacups and saucers, each cup holds a miniature glowing galaxy with tiny stars and nebulae, mirrored liquid surface reflects the cups perfectly, gentle steam rises forming soft luminous clouds, delicate blue floral patterns on white porcelain, golden rim details catch the light, surreal dreamlike atmosphere, cinematic lighting, ultra detailed, 8k resolution, macro perspective showing both vastness and intricate details
caption:
What if every cup of tea held a universe? 🌌☕

Sometimes the smallest vessels carry the biggest wonders.
